context.transcript:
I'm Alberto Giordano, the owner of Alberto's Pasta Sauces, and I'm honored to be a speaker at this year's Artisanal Foods Conference.
Like all of us here, I faced many challenges when I decided to start my business three years ago.
Back then I used to sell my products only from my home, but now I'm very proud to say that Alberto's Pasta Sauces are sold in supermarkets throughout the country —a remarkable achievement.
No matter how much my company grows in the future, I will continue to honor my grandmother's traditional recipes through my commitment to using traditional techniques.
After all, I believe that has been the key to the brand's success.
context.transcript_translation:
我是阿尔贝托·吉奥尔达诺，阿尔贝托意大利面酱的拥有者，我很荣幸能成为今年手工食品大会的演讲嘉宾。
像我们所有人一样，三年前决定创业时我都面临了许多挑战。
那时我只在我家销售我的产品，但现在我非常自豪地说，阿尔贝托意大利面酱在全国各地的超市都有售——这是一个非凡的成就。
无论我的公司将来发展得多大，我都会通过致力于使用传统技术来传承祖母的传统食谱。
毕竟，我相信这是品牌成功的关键。
